title: Minefy
tagline: Convert Employee experience letter into NFT so it cannot be faked while sending it to another organioztion or college
description:
Companies sign-in to minefy and create their account, they should provide their basic details and should have metamask wallet providing us the public key would be sufficient.
Whenever an employee leaves an organization, company would send them experience letter via mail which can be altered by the employee while applying for other organizations or colleges, so companies instead of sending a document can use our platform to mint experience letter as NFT and send it to their wallet
how_its_made:
Minefy uses ERC721 token to mint unique tokens for each Employer:Employee,
Hardhat to deploy contract and access abi's
Javascript and react for the beautiful frontend
Metemask wallet to confirm and store NFT's
